mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and a warm 79 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, with a waxing crescent moon and a visible space station pass happening tonight at 10:19 PM.

The City of Verona is highlighting sustainable habits, sharing that apartment residents can drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the City is actively working to transition streetlights and City Hall fixtures to energy-efficient LED bulbs.

We have some great local events coming up. Saturday, July 18th is packed with live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, plus the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Looking ahead to next week, the Verona Downtown Farmers Market returns to Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In the weekly police report, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way where a driver was cited for failing to yield after causing minor injuries to another motorist.
Finish your evening with today's delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day at Culver's. They are open until 10:30 PM tonight, and tomorrow's flavor will be Turtle.
